title: 18 Day Uganda Birding Expedition
rank_math_title: Uganda Birding Expedition: 18 Amazing Days to Murchison
rank_math_desc: Uganda birding expedition for 18 days: Mabamba, Lake Mburo, Bwindi, Ruhija, Queen Elizabeth, Semliki, the Royal Mile and Murchison Falls. Price on request.
post_content: This Uganda birding expedition travels anticlockwise from Lake Victoria to the Albertine Rift, Semliki, Budongo and the Nile at Murchison Falls.
overview:
This Uganda birding expedition is our longest Ugandan route. In 18 days it visits nearly every major birding site in the country, ending with a cruise on the Nile at Murchison Falls.

The pace allows two nights at most stops, so you have time to search properly for difficult forest birds.

Why choose this Uganda birding expedition?

  • Entebbe and Mabamba: turacos, then the shoebill by boat.
  • Lake Mburo: African finfoot and white-backed night heron.
  • Buhoma and Ruhija: Albertine Rift endemics in two parts of Bwindi.
  • Queen Elizabeth: Kasenyi plains and the Kazinga Channel.
  • Semliki, Budongo and Murchison: Congo Basin birds, the Royal Mile and the Nile.

Where you stay

Lodges include an Entebbe hotel, a hotel in Mbarara, Buhoma Tented Camp, a lodge at Ruhija, Mweya Safari Lodge, Semliki Safari Lodge, Mountains of the Moon Hotel, Masindi Hotel and Paraa Safari Lodge, or similar.

Best time for a Uganda birding expedition

Birding is good all year. The drier months are easiest for forest walking, while the wet months bring breeding activity and fewer visitors.

Read our Uganda national parks guide and browse all birding safaris. Gorilla trekking can be added in Bwindi; see our Bwindi gorilla guide. Park permits come from the Uganda Wildlife Authority.

How much does the Uganda birding expedition cost?

Price on request. The cost depends on your travel dates, group size, the season and the lodges you choose, so we prepare every quote personally rather than showing one fixed price.

WhatsApp us on +254 706 223888, email bookings@divulgeadventures.com or send the enquiry form on this page, and we will share a detailed quote for your dates.

faq.q: How long is the Uganda birding expedition?
faq.a: It is 18 days, from arrival in Entebbe to departure from Entebbe.
Not by default, but a gorilla trek can easily be added in Buhoma or Ruhija.
An Entebbe hotel, a Mbarara hotel, Buhoma Tented Camp, a Ruhija lodge, Mweya Safari Lodge, Semliki Safari Lodge, Mountains of the Moon Hotel, Masindi Hotel and Paraa Safari Lodge, or similar.

faq.q: How many species can I expect?
faq.a: Experienced birders often pass 500 species on this route.

faq.q: Is there a lot of driving?
faq.a: Yes, it is a long loop, but most stops have two nights and every drive includes birding.

faq.q: What is special about the Royal Mile?
faq.a: It is a wide forest track in Budongo with excellent views of forest birds such as chocolate-backed kingfisher.

faq.q: Can I fly back from Murchison?
faq.a: Yes. A scheduled flight from Murchison to Entebbe can replace the final drive.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Entebbe
itinerary.content: Airport pick-up and transfer to your hotel.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Entebbe Botanical Gardens
itinerary.content: A relaxed day of birding in the botanical gardens for great blue and Ross's turacos and hornbills.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Mabamba to Mbarara
itinerary.content: Boat trip in Mabamba for the shoebill and lesser jacana, then drive to Mbarara.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Lake Mburo National Park
itinerary.content: Boat trip and park tracks for African finfoot, white-backed night heron and rufous-bellied heron.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Mbarara to Bwindi
itinerary.content: Drive through the Kabale highlands to Buhoma Tented Camp, birding along the way.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Buhoma forest
itinerary.content: A full day on the forest trails for alethes, cuckoo-shrikes and negrofinches.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Buhoma to Ruhija
itinerary.content: Bird the Neck and the river on the way to Ruhija.

itinerary.label: Day 8
itinerary.title: Ruhija
itinerary.content: A full day for handsome francolin, Grauer's warbler and Shelley's crimsonwing.

itinerary.label: Day 9
itinerary.title: Ruhija to Queen Elizabeth via Ishasha
itinerary.content: Drive north via Ishasha's pools to Mweya Safari Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 10
itinerary.title: Kasenyi and Kazinga Channel
itinerary.content: Early game drive on the Kasenyi plains and an afternoon boat trip.

itinerary.label: Day 11
itinerary.title: Queen Elizabeth to Semliki
itinerary.content: Drive to Semliki for humid forest birding. Overnight at Semliki Safari Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 12
itinerary.title: Semliki National Park
itinerary.content: A full day for white-bellied kingfisher, red-billed dwarf hornbill and forest robins.

itinerary.label: Day 13
itinerary.title: Semliki to Fort Portal
itinerary.content: Morning birding in Semliki, then a short drive to Mountains of the Moon Hotel.

itinerary.label: Day 14
itinerary.title: Fort Portal to Masindi
itinerary.content: Drive north with stops in forest patches. Overnight at Masindi Hotel.

itinerary.label: Day 15
itinerary.title: Budongo's Royal Mile
itinerary.content: A pre-dawn start for the Royal Mile, with chocolate-backed kingfisher and malimbes.

itinerary.label: Day 16
itinerary.title: Masindi to Murchison Falls
itinerary.content: Drive over the escarpment and cross the Nile by ferry to Paraa Safari Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 17
itinerary.title: Nile cruise and game drive
itinerary.content: Boat cruise towards the delta for goliath heron and northern carmine bee-eater, then an afternoon game drive.

itinerary.label: Day 18
itinerary.title: Murchison to Entebbe
itinerary.content: Drive back via Kampala to Entebbe for your flight.
